name: Meguri Meguru.
summary:
An RPG set in a fantasy world where you can freely explore.

Dialogue events are kept to a minimum, with a primary focus on combat and character progression. The protagonist’s actions are entirely up to the player. You can follow the main storyline, devote yourself to helping others and building a reputation, or even walk a darker path—becoming a criminal and living as a wanted outlaw.

There are over 40 recruitable characters. In addition to combat, the game features a wide range of activities, including delivery jobs, bounty hunting, blacksmithing, armor crafting, item creation, equipment synthesis, farming, cooking, fishing, and gathering—offering a full suite of life skills.
